query:
SELECT 
  searchId,
  COUNT(*) as total_visits,
  SUM(CASE WHEN companyId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matched_to_company,
  SUM(CASE WHEN companyId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unmatched
FROM leadinfo_visits 
WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003)
GROUP BY searchId;
